LanguageData.MegaMod_RecipeDesc: In-game real-time recipe editor for vanilla and all modded RecipeDefs. Customize ingredient lists, work amounts (crafting time), names, or disable recipes completely.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ResetAllConfirm: Are you sure you want to revert all custom recipe tweaks to vanilla defaults? This will erase all your saved recipe modifications.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ResetAllSuccess: All recipes have been reset to vanilla defaults.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RecipeHelp: Tip: Edits made in the Recipe Editor take effect immediately and are saved automatically across game restarts.
LanguageData.SLM_OnlyColonists_Desc: When enabled, multipliers and benefits apply exclusively to player colonists and faction members.
LanguageData.SLM_DisableDailyCap_Desc: RimWorld penalizes learning speed by 80% after gaining 4,000 XP in a day. Enabling this removes that penalty entirely.
LanguageData.SLM_DisableSkillDecay_Desc: Prevents skills above level 10 from losing XP over time.
LanguageData.SLM_UseGlobalMultiplier: Use Global Multiplier for All Skills
LanguageData.SLM_UseGlobalMultiplier_Desc: When checked, the global slider applies to every skill. Uncheck to configure each skill independently.
LanguageData.SLM_IndividualNotice: Note: Global multiplier is currently active. Uncheck 'Use Global Multiplier' above to apply individual values.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_EnableAccuracy_Desc: Replaces vanilla's harsh distance penalty with a ballistic curve, making skilled shooters deadly at long range.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_FalloffMult_Desc: Higher values reduce accuracy at extreme ranges.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_DamageMult_Desc: Increases raw damage dealt by ranged projectiles.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_ApMult_Desc: Increases bullet armor penetration, making armor quality crucial.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_SpeedMult_Desc: Increases projectile travel velocity for snappier gunplay.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_EnableStagger_Desc: Bullets slow incoming targets regardless of pawn body size.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_StaggerSpeedFactor_Desc: Target move speed while staggered (lower = heavier slow).
LanguageData.LethalRanged_Prevent1Hp_Desc: Removes vanilla's artificial rule that forces vital body parts to survive with 1 HP when taking fatal single hits.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_AffectTurrets_Desc: When checked, defensive turrets also benefit from the improved ballistic formula.
